description: This file defines a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that checks C# interface method parameters to ensure no reference (`ref`) modifiers are used in methods implementing a specific interface (`IAddressable`). It is part of static code analysis tools within the Orleans project.

classes.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer that enforces no use of ref parameters in methods of interfaces implementing IAddressable, raising errors if such parameters are found.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context to analyze method declarations and report diagnostics.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes method syntax nodes to identify methods with ref parameters in interfaces implementing IAddressable and reports diagnostics.
